items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: I met him by Papa John Sharp.

ctx.x: And Punch... I met Punch. I met Punch. Punch said that New Orleans musician... I met him by Papa John Sharp. Yeah. And he said that New Orleans musician didn't have much fun. And so I put him with the rink-a-dinks. Oh, yeah. I put Punch with me. Mm-hmm. And Punch stayed with me a long time. He was playing first trumpet and my son was playing second trumpet on the Punch. I had the band in with Punch and Herman Cham was still there and myself.
